# nuclei-templates fixtures (trimmed)

Shapes modelled on projectdiscovery/nuclei-templates (MIT — Copyright (c) 2025 ProjectDiscovery, Inc.), the five
worked examples and the counter-examples of docs/research/action/08-poc-sources.md §3. They are **trimmed
reconstructions for the tests**, not byte copies: line numbers differ from upstream, and exploit requests are cut down
to the feature a rule needs (defensive design constraint: no full exploit request is transcribed). The radar itself
always reads the real file at a pinned commit SHA (radar.pocs).
